notes.title: NEW DLC
notes.content:
[h2][b]🔥 New DLC Announcement: Bloodlines of Rebellion Now Available![/b][/h2][p]Loyal subjects and brave rebels,[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce the launch of our brand new DLC, [b]"Bloodlines of Rebellion"[/b], a dramatic new chapter in the [i]Thronebreaker[/i] saga!
This story-driven expansion picks up where the main game left off — the kingdom is in turmoil, the crown is under threat, and YOUR choices will determine the fate of your bloodline.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🗡️ What Awaits You in Bloodlines of Rebellion?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]A fresh narrative arc[/b] with hours of new gameplay, choices, and unexpected twists.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deep political intrigue:[/b] Unmask traitors, face powerful villains, and make decisions that echo through the realm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More impactful choices:[/b] Every decision you make shapes the destiny of your kingdom, your family, and yourself.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiple endings:[/b] Will you restore peace, or plunge the realm into chaos?[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Prepare for new dangers, new alliances, and the most difficult choices yet. The shadows gather, and your reign will be tested like never before.[/b][/p][p][i]Available now! Play the DLC and continue your legacy in the world of Thronebreaker.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Note:[/b][/h3][p]If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please share your feedback in the community forum. Thank you for your support![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Stay tuned for more updates and future content![/b][/p]
